ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75% low-intensity (dark/black) to 25% high-intensity (white) across visible ventral surface area.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) oriented diagonally on the high-intensity patch of the right lobe and vertically on the left lobe margin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of multiple white circular scars (barnacle attachment points) and dark linear scarring/rake marks across both lobes.
